title: His son Chris's remark about people of all colors
summary: Leeman's wife recalls their two-and-a-half-year-old Chris saying that if God made people all the same the world would be monotonous.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: I have to add this. My wife just heard this tape back so far, especially on the race conversations, and she reminds me that when my son Chris was two and a half years

old (he's now 26) but when he was two and a half years old, he was riding on a bus with her, and he noticed a black woman on the bus and he said to my wife, as children will, about the color and why and so forth. And Irene was explaining to him that God made people in all colors, and two and a half year old Chris looked at her and said, 'If he made them all the same, it would be an awfully monotonous world' ...
